title: Ben and the Sign That Went Missing
synopsis: Ben and Sue search for the garden sign hidden by a sunflower leaf until Grandpa Ed and Grandma May move it to a readable place along the dry path.
continuity_state: Before: Sunflower leaves obscure the small LITTLE GROWING GARDEN board on its original path-side peg. Sue is familiar with the Story House, and Grandpa Ed repaired its door. After: With Grandma May present, Grandpa Ed relocates the existing garden sign and peg a short distance along the same dry approach, outside the sunflower leaves and without narrowing the path or touching the plants. Sue and Ben visit together and joke about the sign. No other permanent props or plants change.

related_resources.reason: The AAP reviews pretend play in broad terms, while the invented moving-word joke is a narrative device, not a treatment.
